description: Read-only cross-run cost rollup from the spend ledger (mirrors the CLI `amicus spend` query flags). Filter by since/wave/council/project/model/op, keep only failed (wasted) rows, and group by a dimension. Returns a versioned spend doc (ids/numbers/paths only, never model-generated text) — never fenced.

council.description: Only rows from this council run id or preset name.

filterProject.description: Only rows whose recorded project dir matches this absolute path (a ledger-row filter, NOT this tool's working-directory selector — the ledger is global, not per-project). Pass '.' to mean the current project dir.

groupBy.description: Group the rollup by this dimension (default 'model'). One of: model, wave, council, project, op, day, tag.

model.description: Only rows whose model id starts with this.

rows.description: Include matching raw rows in the result, capped at 1000.

since.description: Only rows from the last N days, as an integer followed by 'd' (e.g. '7d').

wave.description: Only rows from this fan-out wave id.

name: amicus_spend
